items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I said, Ben, what did he do about that arrangement

ctx.x: Same type of arrangement that you had for the WPA band?

Only one thing, I think I kind of escalated it a little more. Instead of de-escalating the work in it, I kind of loosened it up a little more, and maybe that's what messed it up. Because the late Ben Webster, when -- one day, on 39th Street. I said, Ben, what did he do about that arrangement, because Duke said he was going to rehearse it when he got to California? I said, what did you do about it? Because I don't think the arrangements is all that hard. He say, What? I said, I don't think the arrangement's all…
You had a reputation for writing hard music.
